name: zn15_23_jog_street
description: Conformance test 23 (jog street, §7.12). Street (12, 5..9) ends one cell north of the zone; zone 4 on x 10..15, z 10..13; SetOptions(0, 1, 0). ExtendAsStreets finds nothing (no network inside the rect). LayInJogStreets(kind 3) line 1 (z = z1-1 = 9): cell (12,9) has a kind-3 network connecting only on facing side 0 (-z, toward (12,8)) -> a dead end pointing at the region; no parallel (±x) connection -> DrawStreet((10,10)->(15,10), perCell 1): the segment Place(10,10,15,10) then per-cell Place(x,10,x,10) for x = 10..15. That street lands on the region's z = 10 row, so SubdivideTheZone's recomputed component is x 10..15, z 11..13 (18 cells). ExamineBoundaries on it: the street row scores side 0 (S[0] = 6 x 30 = 180); S = {180, 3, 6, 3}, C = {1,0,0,0}, D = 0, Q = 3, flag 1 (zone 4, no swap). Parcellize lays three full-depth lots (case (b): rem 3 <= maxDepth).
